SELECT HRE.LOCAL_NAME, HRE.EMPID, get_dept_name(HRE.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)DEPTNAME, get_global_name(HRE.POST_GRADE_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)POST_GRADE, ARSM.PERSON_ID, ARSM.SHIFT_NO, get_global_name(ARSM.SHIFT_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)SHIFT_NO_NAME, get_global_name(ARSM.BEFOR_SHIFT_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)BEFOR_SHIFT_NO, TO_CHAR(ARSM.START_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY')START_DATE, ARSM.REMARK, HRE.DEPTNO, ARSM.AR_SHIFTGROUP_MANAGE_NO, get_emp_local_name(ARSM.CREATED_BY,#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#) || ' '||ARSM.CREATED_IP CREATED_BY, TO_CHAR(ARSM.CREATE_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')CREATE_DATE, get_emp_local_name(ARSM.UPDATED_BY,#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#) || ' '||ARSM.UPDATED_IP UPDATED_BY, TO_CHAR(ARSM.UPDATE_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')UPDATE_DATE FROM AR_SHIFTGROUP_MANAGEMENT ARSM,HR_EMPLOYEE HRE,SY_CODE SC WHERE ARSM.PERSON_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID AND ARSM.ACTIVITY = 1 AND HRE.POST_GRADE_NO = SC.CODE_NO(+) AND HRE.EMPID NOT LIKE '11111%' AND (HRE.DATE_LEFT IS NULL OR HRE.DATE_LEFT >= SYSDATE) AND HRE.EMP_TYPE_CODE <> '10418'
( HRE.EMPID LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(upper(HRE.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE CONVERTTOUNSIGN(upper('%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%')) )
TO_CHAR(ARSM.START_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') = #START_DATE:VARCHAR#
ARSM.SHIFT_NO = #SHIFT_NO:VARCHAR#
HRE.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
( ARSM.PERSON_ID,ARSM.CREATE_DATE) IN( SELECT TT.PERSON_ID,MAX(TT.CREATE_DATE) FROM AR_SHIFTGROUP_MANAGEMENT TT WHERE TT.ACTIVITY = 1 GROUP BY TT.PERSON_ID )
( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO B WHERE B.DEPTNO = HRE.DEPTNO AND B.PERSON_ID = #supervisorPersonId# AND ROWNUM = 1 ) OR HRE.PERSON_ID = #supervisorPersonId# )
HRE.DEPTNO in ($DEPTNO_Multi$)
ORDER BY HRE.DEPTNO,SC.ORDERNO,HRE.EMPID,ARSM.CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT HRE.LOCAL_NAME, HRE.EMPID, get_dept_name(HRE.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)DEPTNAME, get_global_name(HRE.POST_GRADE_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)POST_GRADE, ARSM.PERSON_ID, ARSM.SHIFT_NO, get_global_name(ARSM.SHIFT_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)SHIFT_NO_NAME, get_global_name((SELECT shift_no FROM AR_CALENDER WHERE ddate = to_date(ARSM.AR_DATE_STR, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AND CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#),#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)BEFOR_SHIFT_NO, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ARSM.AR_DATE_STR,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'DD/MM/YYYY')START_DATE,
HRE.DEPTNO, get_emp_local_name(ARSM.CREATED_BY,#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#) || ' '||ARSM.CREATED_IP CREATED_BY, TO_CHAR(ARSM.CREATE_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')CREATE_DATE, get_emp_local_name(ARSM.UPDATED_BY,#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#) || ' '||ARSM.UPDATED_IP UPDATED_BY, TO_CHAR(ARSM.UPDATE_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')UPDATE_DATE FROM AR_SCHEDULE_HAE ARSM,HR_EMPLOYEE HRE,SY_CODE SC WHERE ARSM.PERSON_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID AND HRE.POST_GRADE_NO = SC.CODE_NO(+) AND HRE.EMPID NOT LIKE '11111%' AND (HRE.DATE_LEFT IS NULL OR HRE.DATE_LEFT >= SYSDATE) AND HRE.EMP_TYPE_CODE <> '10418'
( HRE.EMPID LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' or HRE.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' )
ARSM.AR_DATE_STR >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#START_DATE:VARCHAR#,'DD/MM/YYYY'),'YYYY/MM/DD')
ARSM.AR_DATE_STR <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#END_DATE:VARCHAR#,'DD/MM/YYYY'),'YYYY/MM/DD')
GET_GLOBAL_NAME(ARSM.SHIFT_NO,'vi') = #SHIFT_NO:VARCHAR#
HRE.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO B WHERE B.DEPTNO = HRE.DEPTNO AND B.PERSON_ID = #supervisorPersonId# AND ROWNUM = 1 ) OR HRE.PERSON_ID = #supervisorPersonId# )
HRE.DEPTNO in ($DEPTNO_Multi$)
ORDER BY HRE.DEPTNO,SC.ORDERNO,HRE.EMPID,ARSM.AR_DATE_STR DESC

SELECT count(ARSM.PERSON_ID) FROM AR_SHIFTGROUP_MANAGEMENT ARSM,HR_EMPLOYEE HRE WHERE ARSM.PERSON_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID AND ARSM.ACTIVITY = 1
( HRE.EMPID LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' or HRE.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' )
TO_CHAR(ARSM.START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') = #START_DATE:VARCHAR#
ARSM.SHIFT_NO = #SHIFT_NO:VARCHAR#
( ARSM.PERSON_ID,ARSM.START_DATE) IN( SELECT TT.PERSON_ID,MAX(TT.START_DATE) FROM AR_SHIFTGROUP_MANAGEMENT TT WHERE TT.ACTIVITY = 1 GROUP BY TT.PERSON_ID )
( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO B WHERE B.DEPTNO = HRE.DEPTNO AND B.PERSON_ID = #supervisorPersonId# AND ROWNUM = 1 ) OR HRE.PERSON_ID = #supervisorPersonId# )
EXISTS( SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HRE.DEPTNO AND HR_DEPARTMENT.ACTIVITY = 1 START WITH (HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = #DEPTNO:VARCHAR# OR #DEPTNO:VARCHAR# = '') CONNECT BY PRIOR HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT.PARENT_DEPT_NO )
sqlMap.update: UPDATE AR_SHIFTGROUP_MANAGEMENT SET ACTIVITY = 0, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #UPDATED_BY#, UPDATED_IP = #UPDATED_IP# WHERE AR_SHIFTGROUP_MANAGE_NO = #SEQ#
